name: A Day To Remember
source:
You play as Aino, wanting to confess her feelings for Rain after being around her for so many years.

Both haven't had much time together cause of adult life, can they strengthen their bond again like old times and maybe become something more? Or will they remain friends?

[Edited from [url=https://lovelycinnamon.itch.io/a-day-to-remember]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演艾诺，想要向与Rain相处多年的她坦白自己的感情。

由于成年生活，两人在一起的时间并不多，他们能否像以前那样再次加强联系，甚至变得更进一步呢？或者他们会继续做朋友吗？

[编辑自[url=https://lovelycinnamon.itch.io/a-day-to-remember]itch.io[/url]]
